<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election Commission scrutiny:</strong> The Supreme Court has granted petitioners 10 days to respond to the Election Commission’s affidavit defending its &quot;unanimous&quot; decisions regarding electoral roll revisions and the status of CEC Gyanesh Kumar.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I32</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Data privacy litigation:</strong> The Supreme Court has sought a formal response from the Union government regarding the exemption granted to journalism under the current data protection law.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I39</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I40</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political realignment:</strong> Former Uttar Pradesh minister Dharmendra Kashyap has joined the Samajwadi Party following the BJP&#x27;s decision to deny him a Rajya Sabha nomination.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I41</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Opposition challenges ECI:</strong> The Congress party has formally rejected the Election Commission&#x27;s affidavit on voter roll revisions, labeling the commission&#x27;s claims as deceptive and duplicitous.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislative and diplomatic agenda:</strong> Rajya Sabha leadership hosted the 12th BRICS Parliamentary Forum in New Delhi, focusing on strengthening international cooperation and trade targets with member nations.</li>
</ul>
